People: William De Lancey Ellwanger (author, Wikidata Q136670137), died 1913. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Ellwanger, William De Lancey, 1854-1913") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: The oriental rug; a monograph on eastern rugs and carpets, saddle-bags, mats & pillows, with a consideration of kinds and classes, types borders, figures, dyes, symbols, etc., together with some practical advice to collectors, New York, Dodd, Mead, 1909, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/orientalrugmonog00ellw. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 85%, 100%, 95% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of William De Lancey Ellwanger, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
